title: ERC-8004 reading reputation with a trusted reviewer list
summary: A reader asks for an agent summary. Without a list of trusted client addresses getSummary reverts; with one it returns a count and a plain mean. Serious scoring reads every entry and the off-chain files.

steps.label: getSummary(agentId, [], "", "")
steps.detail: An empty reviewer list is refused. The text says unfiltered results are open to Sybil and spam attacks.

payload.content:
// Illustrative example, spec version Draft 2026-01-25.
ReputationRegistry(0x8004BAa17C55a88189AE136b182e5fdA19dE9b63).getSummary(4242, new address[](0), "", "")

steps.label: getClients(agentId)
steps.detail: The reader lists every address that ever rated the agent and decides which ones it trusts, for example addresses with a paid history or a known operator.

steps.label: getSummary(agentId, trustedClients, "starred", "")
steps.detail: The reference code skips revoked entries, filters by tags, normalizes every value to 18 decimals, takes a plain mean and reports it at the most common valueDecimals. There is no weighting.

steps.label: Return count, summaryValue, summaryValueDecimals
steps.detail: A count of matching entries and the mean. Appended responses do not change it.

payload.content:
// Illustrative example, spec version Draft 2026-01-25.
(count=2, summaryValue=85, summaryValueDecimals=0)

steps.label: readAllFeedback(agentId, trustedClients, tag1, tag2, false)
steps.detail: For off-chain scoring the reader pulls the parallel arrays of clients, indexes, values, decimals, tags and revoked flags, then the NewFeedback events for the file URIs.

failures.condition: The agent has very many entries
failures.outcome: The loop grows with every entry; large reads can hit RPC gas limits, so indexers read events instead.

steps.label: Fetch feedback files
steps.detail: The reader fetches each feedbackURI, checks feedbackHash, and can weight entries that carry a verifiable proofOfPayment higher.
